title: Japanese-Style Pasta Stir Fry
description: A fusion of Japanese flavors with Italian pasta, featuring a savory stir-fry sauce and crunchy vegetables.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat the sesame oil over medium-high heat.
Add the bell peppers and broccoli to the pan and stir-fry until they are tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and black pepper.
Add the soy sauce mixture to the pan and stir-fry for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the pan, tossing to combine with the vegetables and sauce.
Serve hot and garnish with green onions if desired.
